messages.content: I joined a team yesterday and the Slack is quiet. Should I introduce myself in the main channel?

Yes, once. A short note works: “Hi, I’m Sam, just joined as the backend engineer. Looking forward to working with you all.” Most teams expect a brief introduction; staying silent the first day can make later messages feel abrupt.
How is frost different from dew?

Dew forms when water vapor condenses into liquid on a surface that is above freezing. Frost forms when the surface is below freezing, so the vapor turns directly into ice crystals (deposition) without becoming liquid first. That’s why frost looks crystalline rather than like droplets.
What was the exact date of the Wright brothers’ first powered flight?
17 December 1903. Orville Wright piloted the first successful flight that morning near Kitty Hawk; three more flights followed the same day.
I worked 47 hours this week at $28 an hour. How much did I earn before taxes?
You earned $1,316 before taxes.
En Barcelona, ¿cómo pido una caña y una tapa?
Di “una caña y una tapa, por favor”. Si quieres algo concreto puedes añadir el nombre: “una caña y unas patatas bravas”.
After I mentioned the attribution issue, the person apologized but then did it again in today’s meeting. What now?

Document the second instance and speak to your manager. “I raised the attribution issue last week and it happened again today with the Q3 numbers. I’d like support making sure sources are credited.” One repeat after a direct conversation is enough to escalate.
Who won the Fields Medal in 2022?

messages.name: web_search
messages.content: Hugo Duminil-Copin, June Huh, James Maynard and Maryna Viazovska.
The 2022 Fields Medalists were Hugo Duminil-Copin, June Huh, James Maynard and Maryna Viazovska.
What do lymph nodes do?

Lymph nodes filter lymph and house immune cells. As lymph passes through, macrophages and lymphocytes detect and respond to pathogens or abnormal cells. Swollen nodes often indicate an active immune response nearby.
Wie sagt man „es gießt wie aus Eimern“ auf Englisch?
Die übliche Übersetzung ist „it’s raining buckets“ oder „it’s pouring“. „It’s coming down in buckets“ ist ebenfalls verbreitet.
Why do we get goosebumps when we’re cold or scared?

Small muscles at the base of each hair follicle contract, pulling the hair upright. In furry animals this traps air for insulation or makes the animal look larger. Humans still have the reflex even though we have little body hair; cold and strong emotion both trigger it via the sympathetic nervous system.

Why does this print 9 three times?

for i in range(3):
    funcs.append(lambda: i*i)
print([f() for f in funcs])

arguments.code:

    funcs.append(lambda: i*i)
print([f() for f in funcs])

messages.content: Each lambda closes over the same variable i. After the loop, i is 2, so every call computes 2*2. Capture the value with a default: lambda i=i: i*i.
Schema for a many-to-many between posts and tags.
電車の中で席を譲ってほしいとき、どう言えばいいですか？
「すみません、席を代わっていただけますか？」と言うのが丁寧です。相手が高齢者や妊婦の場合に使います。
When was the first public radio broadcast?

Reginald Fessenden transmitted voice and music on Christmas Eve 1906 from Brant Rock, Massachusetts. Listeners on ships heard him play the violin and read from the Bible. Regular broadcasting came later in the 1920s.
My parents want to visit during a busy work week. How do I set hours without sounding cold?

“I’d love to see you. I have to work 9 to 5 those days, so evenings and the weekend are free—does that work?” Naming the constraint and immediately offering the available time keeps it warm and clear.
Why are free-floating bubbles always spherical?
Surface tension minimizes the surface area for a given volume of air. The shape with the smallest surface area is a sphere, so the soap film pulls itself into that form once it leaves the wand.
What database URL is in the .env file?

The database URL is postgres://localhost:5432/app.
Como agradeço formalmente a um cliente?
Pode dizer “Agradeço a sua atenção” ou “Muito obrigado pelo seu tempo”. Ambas são adequadas em contexto profissional.
When was the first live satellite television broadcast between continents?
1962. Telstar 1 relayed the first live transatlantic television pictures on 23 July 1962, linking the United States and Europe.
Why is yawning contagious?

Seeing or hearing someone yawn activates mirror-neuron systems and can trigger the same motor pattern in the observer. The effect is stronger among people who are socially close and is thought to be linked to empathy and group synchronization, though the full mechanism is still studied.
I need to cancel dinner plans I made last week because work exploded. How do I say it cleanly?

“I’m sorry—I have to cancel tonight. Work turned into a fire drill. Can we reschedule for next week?” Apologize, give the real reason in one clause, and offer a new time. Most people accept that without further explanation.
Why do opposite poles of a magnet attract?

Magnetic field lines run from north to south. When opposite poles face each other, the field lines connect smoothly between them, lowering the energy of the system. The magnets move to maintain that lower-energy configuration, which we feel as attraction.
What’s today’s total revenue?

arguments.query: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) = date('now')

messages.content: Today’s total revenue is $4,280.50.
كيف أقول مساء الخير؟
تقول "مساء الخير". والرد الشائع هو "مساء النور".
When did email first support attachments?

The MIME standard that made reliable attachments possible was published in 1992. Before that, some systems used ad-hoc methods, but MIME is what allowed attachments to work consistently across different email programs.
I check Slack every few minutes and lose focus. What’s one setting change that helps?

Turn off badge counts and banner notifications, then schedule two or three fixed check times (for example 10:30, 1:30, 4:30). The removal of the visual cue plus the scheduled windows breaks the reflex without making you unreachable.
How do I iterate over two lists in parallel in Python?
Use zip: for a, b in zip(list1, list2): print(a, b). It stops when the shorter list ends.
Why is it important that ice floats on ponds?

Because ice floats, it forms an insulating layer on the surface. The water underneath stays liquid and above freezing, so fish and other life can survive the winter. If ice sank, ponds and lakes would freeze solid from the bottom up.
What’s on my calendar Monday morning?

messages.name: calendar
messages.content:
09:00 Planning
11:00 Design review
Monday morning you have planning at 9:00 and design review at 11:00.
Comment saluer un client que je rencontre pour la première fois ?
Dites « Bonjour, enchanté » ou « Bonjour, ravi de vous rencontrer ». C’est poli et adapté à une première rencontre professionnelle.
When was the first transcontinental railroad in the United States completed?
10 May 1869, when the Central Pacific and Union Pacific lines met at Promontory Summit, Utah. The golden spike ceremony marked the completion.
It’s a quiet Friday and I feel guilty not looking busy. Is that normal?

Yes. Use the quiet for one deferred task or for planning next week, then stop. Constant visible busyness is not required; finishing the actual work is. A calm Friday is a sign the week went reasonably well.
Why do chili peppers feel hot?

They contain capsaicin, which binds to TRPV1 receptors that normally detect heat and pain. The brain interprets the signal as burning even though there is no actual temperature change. Dairy helps because casein can displace the capsaicin.
Does the shape of a boat matter for floating, or only its average density?

Both. Average density must be less than water, which the enclosed air achieves. The shape also determines stability: a wide hull resists tipping, while a narrow one may float but capsize easily. Density gets it afloat; shape keeps it upright.
I bought an item for $45 and want a 40 % markup. What’s the selling price?
The selling price with a 40 % markup is $63.
上司に遅れたことを謝るにはどう言いますか？
「遅れてしまい申し訳ございません」と言うのが丁寧です。より短くするなら「遅れてすみません」でも通じますが、上司には前者の方が適切です。
Where does the term “computer bug” come from?

In 1947, engineers working on the Harvard Mark II found a moth trapped in a relay. They taped it into the logbook and noted “first actual case of bug being found.” The term “bug” for a defect already existed, but this incident popularized it.
I was asked to facilitate a meeting and I’m not the most senior person. How do I keep it on track?

Open with the goal and the end time, then park off-topic items visibly. “Let’s capture that for later and stay on the decision we need today.” Seniority matters less than consistently returning the group to the stated outcome.
Why is the crust of bread darker and firmer than the inside?

The surface reaches higher temperatures and loses moisture, allowing the Maillard reaction and some caramelization to proceed further. The interior stays cooler and moister, so it cooks but does not brown as much.
Why do TV remotes use infrared instead of radio in most cases?

Infrared LEDs and receivers are inexpensive, use very little power, and do not require regulatory approval the way radio transmitters do. Line-of-sight is acceptable for a remote pointed at a television, so the cheaper technology won for decades.

¿Cómo agradezco a un profesor por su ayuda?
Puedes decir “Muchas gracias por su ayuda, profesor” o “Le agradezco mucho su tiempo”. Ambas son respetuosas.
What was one of the earliest widely used email clients?
Elm, released in 1986, was one of the first full-screen email clients for Unix and became widely used on early internet systems. Pine followed in the early 1990s and was also very popular.
I want to ask for a raise but I don’t know how to start the conversation. What’s a clean opener?

“I’d like to discuss my compensation in light of the results from the last two quarters. Can we set 20 minutes this week?” It states the topic, ties it to outcomes, and asks for a dedicated slot instead of ambushing a 1:1.
Why are some stars red and others blue?

Surface temperature. Hotter stars emit more blue and ultraviolet light and appear blue-white. Cooler stars emit more red and infrared and appear orange or red. The color is a direct indicator of temperature.
Why do ice rinks stay frozen indoors?

A network of pipes under the ice carries refrigerated coolant that keeps the slab below freezing. The refrigeration system continuously removes heat so the surface stays solid even when the air temperature in the building is above freezing.
What is the population of New York City?

messages.name: web_search
messages.content: Approximately 8.3 million in the five boroughs.
New York City has approximately 8.3 million people in the five boroughs.
Wie entschuldigt man sich formell für eine verspätete Antwort?
„Entschuldigen Sie bitte die verspätete Antwort“ oder „Bitte entschuldigen Sie, dass ich erst jetzt antworte.“ Beides ist höflich und üblich.
What was the first webcam used for?

In 1991 researchers at the University of Cambridge pointed a camera at a coffee pot so they could see from their desks whether the pot was empty. It was later connected to the early web and became a minor landmark.
A recurring meeting was added to my calendar that I don’t need to attend. How do I remove myself cleanly?
Decline the series and add a one-line note: “I’ll skip these unless there’s a specific item that needs me—feel free to pull me in when that happens.” It removes you without closing the door.
Why do some onions make me cry more than others?

The amount of the sulfur compounds that produce the tear-inducing gas varies by variety, growing conditions, and freshness. Sweeter onions generally have lower levels; stronger storage onions release more. Chilling the onion before cutting also reduces the effect.
Why are airplane windows rounded instead of square?

Square windows concentrate stress at the corners. Under repeated pressurization cycles those corners can crack. Rounded windows distribute the stress more evenly, which is why the de Havilland Comet’s square windows were replaced with rounded ones after early failures.
How many users are currently logged in?

messages.content: There are 42 users currently logged in.
Comment remercier quelqu’un qui vous a invité à dîner ?
Dites « Merci pour le dîner, c’était délicieux » ou « Merci beaucoup pour l’invitation ». Les deux sont chaleureux et naturels.
When was the first SMS text message sent?
3 December 1992. Neil Papworth, an engineer at Vodafone, sent “Merry Christmas” from a computer to a colleague’s phone on the Vodafone network in the UK.
The team wants to do a lunch and I prefer not to go every time. How do I opt out sometimes without disappearing?
Go occasionally and decline others with a light reason: “I’ll sit this one out—catch you at the next.” Showing up some of the time keeps you connected; declining every time is what creates distance.
Why does milk curdle when I add lemon juice?

The acid lowers the pH and causes the casein proteins to lose their charge repulsion and clump together. Those clumps are the curds. The same process is used intentionally when making cheese or paneer.
How does a pencil eraser remove graphite?

The eraser is sticky enough to grab the graphite particles and lift them off the paper fibers. Rubbing also generates a little heat and abrasion that helps detach the marks. The “crumbs” you brush away are eraser material mixed with the lifted graphite.
What is 6 factorial?
6 factorial is 720.
睡觉前怎么跟家人说晚安？
说“晚安”就可以。如果想更亲切一点，可以加“做个好梦”。
When did commercial video calling become practical?

The first commercial picturephone service appeared in the 1960s but was expensive and little used. Practical, widespread video calling arrived with consumer internet and webcams in the late 1990s and early 2000s, then exploded with smartphones and services like Skype and FaceTime.
In brainstorms I think of ideas after the meeting ends. How do I get them in without dominating?

Send a short follow-up within an hour: “One more idea that occurred to me after we hung up—[one sentence]. Happy to drop it if it’s not useful.” It adds the thought without reopening the whole discussion.
Why do bubbles suddenly appear when I open a soda?

The liquid is supersaturated with carbon dioxide under pressure. When you open the bottle the pressure drops, and the dissolved CO₂ comes out of solution as bubbles, often nucleating on tiny imperfections in the glass or can.
Why can’t one key open every lock of the same brand?

Each lock has a unique arrangement of pin lengths. The key’s cuts must lift every pin to the exact shear line for that specific lock. A different key leaves at least one pin blocking the plug, so it will not turn.

كيف أرحب بضيف في البيت؟
قل "أهلاً وسهلاً" أو "تفضل". كلاهما دافئ ومستخدم يومياً.
What was one of the earliest web search engines?
Archie, created in 1990, indexed FTP archives. WebCrawler (1994) was among the first to index full text of web pages. AltaVista and others followed quickly in the mid-1990s.
We finished the agenda with 15 minutes left. Should I end the meeting?
Yes. “We’ve covered everything—I’ll give you the time back.” Ending early is almost always appreciated and trains the group that meetings stop when the work is done.
Why does the sky look paler near the horizon on a clear day?

You are looking through a longer path of atmosphere. More air molecules scatter light from many directions, mixing the blue with white sunlight and making the color lighter and less saturated than the deeper blue overhead.
Why does a balloon pop when you prick it?

The rubber is under tension. A small hole lets the stress concentrate at the tear; the tear then races around the balloon faster than the air can escape gently, releasing the stored energy all at once as a pop.
A $120 item is 25 % off. What’s the final price?
The final price is $90.
夕方に人に会ったとき、何と言いますか？
「こんばんは」と言うのが一般的です。日が暮れてから使います。
When was the first barcode scanned in a store?
26 June 1974, at a Marsh supermarket in Troy, Ohio. The first item scanned was a pack of Wrigley’s chewing gum.
I sent a proposal three days ago and haven’t heard back. When should I follow up?

After three business days is reasonable. A short note works: “Checking whether you had a chance to look at the proposal—happy to answer any questions.” One follow-up is normal; multiple in the same week usually isn’t.
Why do ice cubes sometimes crack when I drop them in a drink?

The outside of the cube warms and expands faster than the cold interior. The uneven expansion creates stress that can fracture the ice. Clearer, slower-frozen cubes with fewer air bubbles tend to crack less.
Why does the volume button on a remote sometimes not work until I point it carefully?

Most remotes use infrared, which travels in a relatively narrow beam and requires line of sight to the receiver on the TV. If the beam misses the sensor or is blocked, the command never arrives. Radio-based remotes are less sensitive to aim.
How much free space is on the data volume?
There are about 50 GB free on the data volume.
Comment dire « good morning » à un groupe de collègues ?
Dites « Bonjour tout le monde ». C’est la formule la plus naturelle et polie.
When did emoji first appear?
Shigetaka Kurita designed the first widely used set of emoji in 1999 for a Japanese mobile carrier. They were later standardized in Unicode, which allowed them to work across platforms.
I’m stuck on a task and don’t want to look incompetent. How do I ask for help?

State what you’ve already tried and the specific point where you’re blocked: “I’ve tried A and B; the error appears when I do C. Have you seen this?” Showing the work you’ve done makes the request look competent, not helpless.
Why do some popcorn kernels not pop?
They usually have a damaged hull or too little internal moisture. Without an intact shell and enough water to build steam pressure, the kernel never reaches the point of rupture and stays hard.
Is the thin water layer under an ice skate caused only by pressure?

Pressure contributes, but friction and the inherent surface properties of ice also matter. Recent research shows that ice has a disordered, liquid-like surface layer even below freezing, and skating friction generates additional heat. All three effects help create the lubricating film.
How many items are in the processing queue?

¿Cómo doy la bienvenida a alguien que llega a mi casa?
Di “Bienvenido” o “Pasa, estás en tu casa”. Ambas son cálidas y naturales.
When did Netflix start streaming?
2007. Netflix launched its streaming service in the United States that year, initially with a limited catalog, while still primarily known for DVD rentals.
I need two hours tomorrow for focused work but my calendar is open. How do I protect it?
Create a busy block titled “Focus – do not book” and set it to show as busy. Most people respect a visible hold; an empty calendar looks available.
How can I estimate how far away lightning is?
Count the seconds between the flash and the thunder, then divide by 5 for miles or by 3 for kilometers. Sound travels roughly 1 mile every 5 seconds (or 1 km every 3 seconds).
How does soap actually remove grease?

Soap molecules have a water-loving head and an oil-loving tail. The tails embed in grease while the heads stay in water, forming tiny spheres (micelles) that lift the grease off the surface and let it rinse away.
Confirm the Spanish for “thank you very much.”

messages.name: web_search
messages.content: Muchas gracias
“Thank you very much” in Spanish is “muchas gracias.”
I have eight tasks and don’t know which to do first. What’s a simple way to order them?

Mark each as urgent or not and important or not. Do the urgent-and-important ones first, then the important-but-not-urgent. Everything else can wait or be delegated. The four-quadrant split removes most of the paralysis.
What was one of the first email viruses?
The Melissa virus in 1999. It spread via infected Word documents attached to email and was one of the first to use address books to propagate rapidly.
Why does the mirror fog faster if the bathroom door is closed?
A closed door traps the moist air from the shower inside the room. The humidity rises faster, so the mirror reaches the dew point sooner and condensation forms more quickly.
What is 17 times 24?
17 times 24 is 408.
Wie heißt man einen Gast willkommen?
Man sagt „Willkommen“ oder „Schön, dass du da bist“. Beides ist freundlich und üblich.
Whats a five-minute ritual that helps me stop working on Friday?
Write the first task for Monday on a note, close every work tab, and shut the laptop. The written hand-off plus the physical close signals that the week is finished.
When was the first scheduled commercial airline flight?
1 January 1914. The St. Petersburg-Tampa Airboat Line flew a Benoist flying boat across Tampa Bay with a paying passenger.
Why does bread go stale even when its not moldy?
Staling is mainly starch retrogradation. The starch molecules recrystallize and push water out of the crumb, making the bread firm. It is a physical change, not microbial spoilage.
Why doesnt a compass point exactly to the geographic North Pole?
Earths magnetic pole is not in the same place as the geographic pole. The difference is called declination and varies by location.
Im going to Osaka and want three phrases for restaurants.
Sumimasen, kore kudasai, and oishii desu. Those cover getting attention, ordering, and complimenting the food.
